text:
Olivia: Quick heads-up 1: found a handful of broken docs after the v2 rollout. Examples referencing `redwood-alpha` and direct `/v1/` links. Opening a tiny fix PR but need eyeballs.

Dan: Which pages? Quickstart / SDK reference / model-mapping?

Olivia: Quickstart, Streaming guide, and embeddings guide. Also a few internal example apps still use `models: ['redwood-alpha']`. v2 expects a single `model` field and updated names (e.g., `redwood-2-small`).

Kevin: I can run a repo-wide search. Suggest we replace exact model aliases only where it's clearly an example, not a historical note.

Maria: Agreed. For historical notes we should keep the old names but mark them as deprecated. Add a short callout: `Note: legacy model aliases (redwood-alpha) are deprecated; use redwood-2-small or consult the model map.`

Olivia: Also some cross-links point to `/v1/streaming` endpoints. We should prefer using the client examples instead of raw URLs to avoid future drift.

Dan: Good point. Example change for Python streaming: replace
```py
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream', json={...})
```
with
```py
resp = client.responses.stream(model='redwood-2-small', input='hi')
```
I'll include that in the PR.

Kevin: I'll prepare a small sed script to handle easy replacements: `git grep -l \"redwood-alpha\" | xargs sed -i \"s/redwood-alpha/redwood-2-small/g\"` then run tests. Will skip docs/legacy/ or historical pages.

DocsBot: New issue created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/912. Labels: docs, patch, migration. Assignees: @Olivia @Kevin. CI will lint snippets automatically.

Maria: One more: update the deprecation banner text to be neutral and clear. Proposed: `Notice: v1 endpoints and legacy model aliases will be retired on 2026-09-30. See /migration/v1-to-v2 for migration steps.` Keep it short and add link.

Olivia: I'll add a tiny migration section on the Quickstart with a before/after diff and a one-liner `sed` for common fixes. Also add a note about callback rename: `on_chunk` -> `on_delta`.

Dan: Can we include an automated check in CI that fails if any docs codeblocks still contain `/v1/`? Could be useful for a month.

Kevin: I'll add a simple grep-based check in docs CI that errors if `/v1/` appears inside fenced code blocks. Will open a follow-up PR for CI.

Maria: Timeline: get the quick fixes merged today (streaming + quickstart + embeddings). Broader model-map cleanup next week.

Olivia: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459 (WIP). Contains targeted edits and the migration snippet.

Dan: Reviewing now. Small nit: use `redwood-2` in examples that want the general latest model, use `redwood-2-small` for constrained examples.

Olivia: Noted. Thanks all. Will ping when PR is ready to merge. :shipit:
